buttons.name: Win Free Dinos - Join Family Now

textContent.value: Join us for our Midweek Afternoon Bonus Auto Reward meet other hosts, and get yourself rewarded.⚡
⏰ Event run time: 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM PST.
First come, First serve! The first 2,000 hosts complete the task will get reward!!!

lv.1 - if 3,000 beans received, get 2,100 beans reward 
lv.2 - if 10,000 beans received, get 3,500 extra beans reward 
lv.3 - if 20,000 beans received, get 5,000 extra beans reward 
lv.4 - if 30,000 beans received, get 5,000 extra beans reward
lv.5 - if 40,000 beans received, get 8,000 extra beans reward

The maximum reward you can receive is 23,600 beans
Go live in Solo or Multiguest Room at least 20 mins within the hour, you can do PK and different livestreaming formats you like!

textContent.value: -We will conduct an audit on Overseas beans (beans received outside of the US/CA region); if the proportion of Overseas beans exceeds 20% of the total beans received, no rewards will be issued 🌍
-Go live for at least 20 mins is required 🕘
- Please do not choose the same time as your other Power Rebate events, otherwise we will only launch the higher reward 🔝
